entries.task_id: paris agreement|adopted|under the united nations framework convention on climate change (the ‘paris agreement’) (4)
entries.description: Paris Agreement adopted under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (the ‘Paris Agreement’) (4)
entries.subject: Paris Agreement
entries.object: under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (the ‘Paris Agreement’) (4)

spans.text: The Union is committed to stepping up efforts to tackle climate change and to delivering on the implementation of the Paris Agreement adopted under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (the ‘Paris Agreement’) (4), guided by its principles and on the basis of the best available scientific knowledge, in the context of the long-term temperature goal of the Paris Agreement.

entries.task_id: climate change|provides|in its 2018 special report on the impacts of global warming of 1
entries.description: Climate Change provides in its 2018 Special Report on the impacts of global warming of 1
entries.subject: Climate Change
entries.object: in its 2018 Special Report on the impacts of global warming of 1

spans.text: (3) The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) provides in its 2018 Special Report on the impacts of global warming of 1,5 °C above pre-industrial levels and related global greenhouse gas emission pathways, in the context of strengthening the global response to the threat of climate change, sustainable development, and efforts to eradicate poverty, a strong scientific basis for tackling climate change and illustrates the need to rapidly step up climate action and to continue the transition to a climate-neutral economy.

entries.task_id: ecosystem services|has|shown in its 2019 global assessment report on biodiversity and ecosystem services a worldwide erosion of biodiversity
entries.description: Ecosystem Services has shown in its 2019 Global Assessment Report on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services a worldwide erosion of biodiversity
entries.subject: Ecosystem Services
entries.object: shown in its 2019 Global Assessment Report on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services a worldwide erosion of biodiversity

spans.text: The Intergovernmental Science-Policy Platform on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services (IPBES) has shown in its 2019 Global Assessment Report on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services a worldwide erosion of biodiversity, with climate change as the third most important driver of biodiversity loss.

entries.task_id: crucial to|contribute|to economic and societal transformation
entries.description: crucial to contribute to economic and societal transformation
entries.subject: crucial to

spans.text: (4) A fixed long-term objective is crucial to contribute to economic and societal transformation, high-quality jobs, sustainable growth, and the achievement of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, as well as to reach in a just, socially balanced, fair and cost-effective manner the long-term temperature goal of the Paris Agreement.

entries.task_id: the commission|has|launched a european climate and health observatory under the european climate adaptation platform climate-adapt
entries.description: the Commission has launched a European climate and health observatory under the European Climate Adaptation Platform Climate-ADAPT
entries.subject: the Commission
entries.object: launched a European climate and health observatory under the European Climate Adaptation Platform Climate-ADAPT

spans.text: As announced in its communication of 24 February 2021 entitled ‘Forging a climate-resilient Europe – the new EU Strategy on Adaptation to Climate Change’, the Commission has launched a European climate and health observatory under the European Climate Adaptation Platform Climate-ADAPT, to better understand, anticipate and minimise the health threats caused by climate change.

entries.task_id: climate action|should|be an opportunity for all sectors of the economy in the union to help secure industry leadership in global innovation
entries.description: Climate action should be an opportunity for all sectors of the economy in the Union to help secure industry leadership in global innovation
entries.subject: Climate action
entries.object: be an opportunity for all sectors of the economy in the Union to help secure industry leadership in global innovation

spans.text: (7) Climate action should be an opportunity for all sectors of the economy in the Union to help secure industry leadership in global innovation.

entries.description: other initiatives adopted at Union level
entries.subject: other initiatives

spans.text: Without prejudice to binding legislation and other initiatives adopted at Union level, all sectors of the economy – including energy, industry, transport, heating and cooling and buildings, agriculture, waste and land use, land-use change and forestry, irrespective of whether those sectors are covered by the system for greenhouse gas emission allowance trading within the Union (‘EU ETS’) – should play a role in contributing to the achievement of climate neutrality within the Union by 2050.

entries.task_id: the commission|should|facilitate sector-specific climate dialogues and partnerships by bringing together key stakeholders in an inclusive and representative manner
entries.description: the Commission should facilitate sector-specific climate dialogues and partnerships by bringing together key stakeholders in an inclusive and representative manner
entries.subject: the Commission
entries.object: facilitate sector-specific climate dialogues and partnerships by bringing together key stakeholders in an inclusive and representative manner

spans.text: In order to enhance involvement of all economic actors, the Commission should facilitate sector-specific climate dialogues and partnerships by bringing together key stakeholders in an inclusive and representative manner, so as to encourage sectors themselves to draw up indicative voluntary roadmaps and to plan their transition towards achieving the Union’s climate-neutrality objective by 2050.

entries.task_id: paris agreement|sets|out a long-term temperature goal in point (a) of article 2(1) thereof
entries.description: Paris Agreement sets out a long-term temperature goal in point (a) of Article 2(1) thereof
entries.subject: Paris Agreement
entries.object: out a long-term temperature goal in point (a) of Article 2(1) thereof

spans.text: (8) The Paris Agreement sets out a long-term temperature goal in point (a) of Article 2(1) thereof, and aims to strengthen the global response to the threat of climate change by increasing the ability to adapt to the adverse impacts of climate change as set out in point (b) of Article 2(1) thereof and by making finance flows consistent with a pathway towards low greenhouse gas emissions and climate-resilient development as set out in point (c) of Article 2(1) thereof.

entries.task_id: this regulation|should|ensure that both the union and the member states contribute to the global response to climate change as referred to in the paris agreement
entries.description: this Regulation should ensure that both the Union and the Member States contribute to the global response to climate change as referred to in the Paris Agreement
entries.subject: this Regulation
entries.object: ensure that both the Union and the Member States contribute to the global response to climate change as referred to in the Paris Agreement

spans.text: As the overall framework for the Union’s contribution to the Paris Agreement, this Regulation should ensure that both the Union and the Member States contribute to the global response to climate change as referred to in the Paris Agreement.
